scope: all verified past soccer IDs in local inventory, retain API aliases separately; no other bookmakers
http_401_403_429: stop new dispatch; save all returned evidence; require review before resume
raw: single atomic gzip http-evidence-v1 envelope, UTC request/response metadata and base64 of captured HTTP body; SHA is decoded body bytes; truncation explicit
prediction_stage: T-10 archive flags and strict minute boundary flags, no training or live model change
availability: actual UTC fetch time today, never backdated to kickoff; same-minute source order unverified
database: separate ENN SQLite, single writer; production DB only used read-only during inventory
